# mcp — MCP tooling router

> The priority rule (indexes first, then MCP tools, skills, memory, manual) lives in
> `AGENTS.md` ("Index-First, Tools-Second") — it is constitution, not part of this router. The evidence
> labels (CONFIGURED / TOOL-SURFACE / VERIFIED-LIVE / NOT-VERIFIED) live in
> `docs/Infrastructure.md`. This router is the operational tooling.

## Choosing a part

| Situation | Part |
|---|---|
| Which MCP tools exist / which fits my task | `parts/mcp-usage/` |
| Batch install/repair servers, fix native bindings and env | `parts/mcp-batch-install-and-repair/` |
| Insert auth keys for a server | `parts/mcp-auth-handler/` |
| Tool-call failures, connection closed, vanished tools, moved project | `parts/mcp-repair/` |
| Hand-write a new MCP server from scratch | `parts/mcp-builder/` (185K — read the sections you need) |
| Ship a server from an OpenAPI contract (Python/TypeScript) | `parts/mcp-server-builder/` |

## Rules

- "Works" only after a real call in the current session — config presence is
  not evidence.
- No restart available → `python _scripts/mcp-call.py <server> <tool> '<json>'`
  (the bridge bypasses the runtime tool passthrough).
- After any server config change: verify with one cheap probe call before
  relying on it.
- `skill-hub` (now a part here via skill-meta) maps the local BrowseMCP /
  SearchMCP ecosystem.
